answer: One concrete defense is to require each agent to post a refundable economic bond before it can act. Spinning up a fake swarm then costs real capital per identity, so the nectar of effortless rewards dries up for sybils. Track each agent reputation as a delta over time: honest work raises it, detected fraud slashes the stake. Reputation cannot be forged in bulk because it accrues slowly, like a plume of verified history trailing each agent, making mass fake identities uneconomical.
